---
name: frontend-design
description: Create polished, distinctive frontend interfaces for components, pages, dashboards, landing pages, and design-system work. Use this when the task is primarily UI or frontend implementation.
---

When using this skill:

- Start by choosing one clear visual direction that fits the product and audience.
- Avoid generic AI-looking UI unless the user explicitly asks for it.
- Prefer production-ready code over mockups.
- Reuse the repo's existing stack, design system, tokens, and component patterns first.
- Make the result accessible, responsive, and keyboard-friendly.
- Include proper hover, focus, active, loading, empty, and error states.
- Keep typography, spacing, and motion intentional and consistent.
- For React or Next.js, prefer TypeScript, semantic HTML, and composable components.
- Briefly explain the chosen design direction before or after the code.
- When requirements are vague, infer a sensible audience and propose one strong design direction instead of giving multiple weak variants.

Quality bar:
- strong hierarchy
- high visual polish
- good spacing rhythm
- tasteful motion
- realistic production structure
- no placeholder-style "AI slop"
